name: Yoga school in Lisbon
reason: No usable school found in three searches. Centro Português de Yoga (one of the city's oldest schools, Avenidas Novas) appeared only in Time Out and listicles; no own site found, and domains are never guessed. The Confederação Portuguesa do Yoga (yoga-samkhya.pt, Yoga Sámkhya, robots.txt allows us) was opened but is a national, guru-centred confederation of many centres with medical and pregnancy departments, not a single Lisbon school; not planned (owner may wish to look at it separately). Other results were directories (BookRetreats, Retreat Guru, Urban Sports Club, Superprof) or a visiting physiotherapist-led training (Nov 2026, already starting).
